newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Keppel to hasten Philippine bank rescue.
newsitem.headline: Keppel to hasten Philippine bank rescue.

text.p: Keppel Corp Ltd said on Friday it would speed implementation of plans for the rehabilitation of the Philippine savings bank it had stepped in to rescue last week.
"Monte de Piedad and Savings Bank (MDPSB) will speed implementation of its rehabilitation plans following encouraging support from depositors and the business sector," Keppel said in a statement.
Keppel said MDPSB had returned to normal operations one day after reopening and had become a net lender to the inter-bank market.
More than 220 million pesos (US$8.3 million) had been deposited with the bank in the past two days and pledges for further deposits were being received, the statement said.

"We are pleased with the level of deposits and support shown since the re-opening of Monte de Piedad and Savings Bank," A.V. Reyes, deputy governor of the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas, Keppel Corp quoted him as saying in the statement.
